entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
?Court No. - 84
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 23261 of 2022
Applicant :- Lal Mohammad

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Sudhir Dixit,Anupam Shyam Dwivedi,Smt. Richa Dixita
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.

When the case is called out, Sri Sudhir Dixit, learned counsel for the applicant submits that the
instant application has been filed against the order dated 30.06.2021 passed by Adjudicating
Officer/Additional District Magistrate (City), Aligarh in Complaint Case No. 01783 of 2019, under
Sections 3(1)(zx), 26(1)(2)(ii), 51 and 58 Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 and against the
impugned order, an appeal is maintainable under Section 70 of Food Safety and Standard Act,
2006, therefore, instant application may be dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to file an appeal
before the appropriate forum.
Learned AGA is having no objection if the instant application is dismissed as withdrawn.
In view thereof, the present application is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as prayed.
Certified copy, if any, be returned to the counsel for the applicant after retaining the xerox copy of the same on record.

Order Date :- 16.8.2022 AK Pandey  Lal Mohammad vs State Of U.P. And Another on 16 August, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/115228041/
